display_title: The Northern Archduke Is So Cute
description:
Timothy Quintbeck(25) ,the 2nd son of Quintbeck family of the southern region dislikes Matthias Paliz(24), the arch duke from the Norther region ..since he believes that the duke dislikes him as he gets avoided by him whenever they meets during party season .. ..But unknown to him the truth is that Matthias actually likes him but doesn't know how to express his feelings ..Then one winter while was Timothy was traveling to north he got lost in a blizzard, and ends up in Matthias's castle.Soon they ends up having one night stand
